extracted.name: Ghoulish grape, apple & grenadine cooler mocktail
extracted.description: Looking for a devilish alcohol-free tipple to serve for Halloween? Our grape, apple and grenadine mocktail will go down a storm at any party
instruction_lines: Freeze the grapes overnight. The following day fill four tall glasses or tumblers with a mix of frozen grapes and ice cubes. Pour the apple juice and chopped mint into a jug with the sparkling water, stir briefly to combine, then divide between the glasses. Pour grenadine into each glass and let it sink to the bottom just before serving.
